exposure: Type of cervical swab (cotton vs polyester)
Neonates of women with puerperal sepsis (n=40)
cohort: Women with puerperal sepsis (n=45) admitted to a tertiary hospital in North India
finding: Escherichia coli was the most common pathogen found in women with puerperal sepsis and was uniformly sensitive to amikacin.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in women with puerperal sepsis (53.3%) compared to vaginal delivery (46.6%).
